name: The Pickle
notes: a walking cartoon gherkin mascot brought to life from a hand-painted pub sign: a bright green pickle for a body, chest-high to an adult, covered in the small bumps and warts of a real pickling cucumber, a huge open grinning mouth with a red tongue, two big round googly cartoon eyes with pale yellow whites and black pupils, thin rubbery green arms and legs straight out of the body with no shoulders or hips, oversized cream-yellow four-fingered cartoon gloves and matching cream-yellow shoes, no clothing, permanently mid-dance with one arm thrown up, gleeful and mischievous, no human features and no face beyond the eyes and mouth
